verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Jesus, God's righteousness revealed
The Son of man, the Son of God
His kingdom comes

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Jesus, redemption's sacrifice
Now glorified, now justified
His kingdom comes

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
And this kingdom shall know no end
And its glory shall know no bound

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
For the majesty and power
Of the kingdom's King has come

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
And this kingdom's reign
And this kingdom's rule

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
And this kingdom's power & authority
Jesus, God's righteousness revealed

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Jesus, the expression of God's love
The grace of God, the word of God
Revealed to us

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Jesus, God's holiness displayed
Now glorified, now justified
His kingdom comes
